title: Default DATABASE_URL creates a stray on-disk file instead of a true in-memory DB
evidence: app.py:28 DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///file::memory:?cache=shared' — SQLAlchemy treats the path literally, producing a 12KB file named 'file::memory:' in the workspace rather than an in-memory database
suggestion: Use 'sqlite:///books.db' for the file-based default (matching the README/tests) or 'sqlite://' + StaticPool for a real shared in-memory DB

title: Unused import: pydantic.validator
evidence: app.py:19 imports `validator` but it is never referenced

title: Pydantic v1-style config (orm_mode) is deprecated under Pydantic v2
evidence: app.py:77 uses `class Config: orm_mode = True`; requirements.txt pins pydantic unversioned (resolves to v2)

title: Validation rejects with 422 (Pydantic default), not 400; no test covers missing title/author
evidence: app.py:56-57 Field(min_length=1) yields HTTP 422 on missing/empty title|author; tests/test_app.py has no negative-validation case
suggestion: Add a test asserting POST /books without title/author is rejected; optionally normalize to 400 if the spec's status code matters
